claims.text: Is INDIA the Highest for Underweight Babies?

claims.support: Global data on low-birthweight baby rates comparing various countries

claims.text: A cinematic data comparison of low-birthweight baby rates using 2020 World Bank data, focusing on India's global high and the gap with other major nations.
India: 27.4% of babies are born underweight. In Iceland, it is 4%.
India has the world's highest rate. A difficult start for newborns weighing less than 2,500 grams.
claims.support: India rank 1; definition: Low-birthweight babies are newborns weighing less than 2,500 grams

claims.text: This counts weight within the 1st hour of life, before significant postnatal weight loss has occurred.
claims.support: definition: with the measurement taken within the first hour of life, before significant postnatal weight loss has occurred

claims.text: India has 3.3 times the underweight newborns the USA has, where 8.3% of babies are underweight.
Bangladesh: 23%, Philippines: 21.1%, and Liberia: 19.9% are also high.
claims.support: Bangladesh display 23%, Philippines display 21.1%, Liberia display 19.9%

claims.text: Japan is a surprise for a wealthy nation at 11.3%.
At the other end, Sweden is just 4.1%.
How common are underweight births where you live?
claims.support: Engaging closing question referencing low-birthweight births
Card corresponding to indicator unit % and low-birthweight babies theme
